title: bupleurum tenuissimum subsp. columnae
intro: Bupleurum tenuissimum subsp. columnae, commonly known as the Chinese Thorny Bupleurum, is a plant species within the Bupleurum genus. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum tenuissimum subsp. columnae include immune system modulation, fever reduction, and detoxification support. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
